newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-KIRSTEN HAT-TRICK HELPS GERMANY TO 3-2 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KIRSTEN HAT-TRICK HELPS GERMANY TO 3-2 WIN.

text.p: Substitute Ulf Kirsten scored a remarkable second-half hat-trick as European champions Germany came from a goal down to beat Albania 3-2 in a dramatic World Cup qualifier on Wednesday.
Albania missed an early penalty, the first of three they were awarded, and then went ahead from a second spot kick converted by Bledar Kola in the 61st minute.
Kirsten was brought on to turn the game around and struck three times between the 64th and 84th minutes before Kola scored his second penalty in the final minute.
The game was played in Spain because of the conflict in Albania.
